requirements.name: Minimum order value validation
requirements.summary: System must enforce a minimum cart total before allowing order submission to ensure economic viability.

requirements.name: Geofenced service area enforcement
requirements.summary: System must block order placement if the delivery address falls outside defined hyperlocal zones.

requirements.name: Real-time stock availability locking
requirements.summary: System must reserve inventory quantities immediately upon order confirmation to prevent overselling.

requirements.name: Product expiry date validation
requirements.summary: System must prevent ordering of items that have passed their shelf-life or are flagged as expired.

requirements.name: Delivery slot capacity verification
requirements.summary: System must verify that a delivery agent has available capacity before assigning a specific time window.

requirements.name: Partner commission rate application
requirements.summary: System must automatically apply the correct revenue share percentage based on the active store agreement.

requirements.name: Regulatory license status check
requirements.summary: System must block operations in a zone if the store partner lacks a valid food safety or business license.

requirements.name: Fraud risk score assessment
requirements.summary: System must evaluate transaction patterns and flag high-risk orders for manual review before processing.
